title: Minimax-regret level design
description: Train on levels chosen adversarially to maximize regret, so rare levels that separate the true goal from proxies get trained on.

source.title: Mitigating Goal Misgeneralization via Minimax Regret
source.authors: Abdel Sadek, Farrugia-Roberts, Anwar, Erlebach, de Witt, Krueger, Dennis

prediction.rationale: Minimax regret's claim: training on levels where the current policy falls short of the best return it has achieved upweights the rare levels where the intended goal and the proxy come apart, so the policy stops pursuing the proxy.
